# C1 input fixtures — labels (written before the detector exists)

These labels are the truth the detector is held to. They come from the contract (`docs/interaction-contract.md` v1:
ICX-CLASS, ICX-BYPASS, ICX-KEY, ICX-SETTLE-8/9/D1), `docs/checkpoint-config.md` v1 and Daniel's feel rules
(decisions-2026-10-15.md): one gesture = one page; "scroll, scroll, scroll" = 3 pages; a long trackpad inertia tail is
ONE step. They were committed on their own, before `assets/shared/checkpoint-input.js` existed (see `git log`).
`tests/checkpoint/test_detector.py` parses the table below; only timing tolerances come from the config.

All streams are **synthetic** (generated by `gen_fixtures.py` from the models below), not device recordings: real
trackpad inertia is C7's job. Times are integer ms (`ev.timeStamp`).

## Models

- **Trackpad flick, 60 Hz** (`dt` 16 ms): finger phase deltas `3, 8, 16, 26, 34, 38` px, then momentum
  `d_k = 38 · r^k` per frame (`r` 0.95 unless stated), quantised to whole px (fractions carry over; a frame with
  < 1 px emits no event), ending when the next event would come > 120 ms after the last one. So the late tail has
  gaps of 32–120 ms but never > 120 ms, and the tail is longer than `REPEAT_MS`.
- **Trackpad flick, 120 Hz** (`dt` 8 ms): finger deltas halved (`2, 4, 8, 13, 17, 19`), `d_k = 19 · r^k` with
  `r` = 0.975 per frame, same quantisation and end rule.
- **Second flick inside a tail** (fingers land again): the tail stops; the next frame starts the new finger phase
  `4, 12, 24, 38, 48, 52` px (60 Hz), then its own momentum `52 · 0.95^k`.
- **Jank tail** (busy main thread, Chrome coalesces wheel events): a 60 Hz flick (or 120 Hz) whose events from
  160 ms on are delivered after gaps cycling `96, 16, 16, 112, 16, 80, 16, 16` ms; each delayed event carries the
  summed (quantised) deltas of the frames it covers. Gaps stay < `QUIET_SMOOTH`, so it is still one gesture.
- **Slow drag**: 4 px every 16 ms (250 px/s), the stated duration.
- **Notch (Chrome)**: `deltaMode 0`, `deltaY ±100`, `wheelDeltaY ∓120`. **Notch (Firefox)**: `deltaMode 1`,
  `deltaY ±3` (lines).
- **Keys**: `keydown` only. A held key: first press at 0 ms, auto-repeat (`repeat: true`) from 500 ms every 33 ms.
- **Touch**: `touchstart` at y 600, `touchmove`s 16 ms apart unless stated, `touchend` 8 ms after the last move.
  Pin height 800 px, so `SWIPE_PX` = max(36, 5 % × 800) = 40 px. Forward = the finger moves up.
- Target is `body` unless stated.

## Columns

- **steps**: the signed steps the detector must emit, in order (`—` = none).
- **jumps**: `first` / `last` (`—` = none).
- **prevented**: which events get `preventDefault()` from the module: `all`, `none`, `tag:<t>` (exactly the events
  tagged `<t>` in the fixture), `from:<ms>` (exactly the events with `t ≥ ms`), or a number (touch).
- **classes**: the class of each wheel gesture in order (ICX-CLASS: decided by its first event, held to its end);
  `—` = no wheel gesture.
